_doc: Station Zero weapons and camos module (add_weapons.py). K1: the map's Pack-a-Punch camos (cp_iwz3.gsc sets pap_1_camo camo01 and pap_2_camo camo04; their donor materials camo_01 / camo_04 are shipped in the map zone with CARRIER and MERCURY ARC). WW1: EXACT CHANGE on the Model 1887 skeleton (donor animation package iw7_1887_mp_package and sound package iw7_mod2187_mp_sfxpackage are STOCK PLACEHOLDERS until our own exist). Variables: CAMOS (camo_gen.py output), WW1 (build_authored_weapon.py output zonetool folder), DUMP (stock dumps root), HERE (this folder).

weapons.name: iw7_exactchange_zm
weapons._why: 05-WONDER-WEAPONS.md 1: single lever-cycled shots at 110 a minute (iFireTime 545), hopper 12, one token (shotCount 1), pierces (penetrateType 3; the script caps victims per shot), damage set by script (onzombiedamage), so the file damage is a low fallback. Ammo stock is kept equal to the clip by the script (no reserve, refills free, Max Ammo no effect).
